def toStr : Formula α → String
  | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | ∼φ      => "\\lnot " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\rightarrow " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

C0_dependencies.name: LO.IntProp.Formula.hasDecEq
C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | ⊤, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _
  | ∼φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hneg φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (by simp[hp])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol
import Foundation.Logic.HilbertStyle.Basic

namespace LO.IntProp

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | verum  : Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | neg    : Formula α → Formula α
  | and    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | or     : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

instance : LogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | ∼φ      => "\\lnot " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\rightarrow " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩
instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

end ToString

@[simp] lemma and_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Wedge.wedge]
@[simp] lemma or_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋎ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋎ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Vee.vee]
@[simp] lemma imp_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ➝ φ₂ = ψ₁ ➝ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Arrow.arrow]
@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by simp[Tilde.tilde]

def complexity : Formula α → ℕ
| atom _  => 0
| ⊤       => 0
| ⊥       => 0
| ∼φ      => φ.complexity + 1
| φ ➝ ψ  => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| φ ⋏ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| φ ⋎ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1

def cases' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
    (hfalsum : C ⊥)
    (hverum  : C ⊤)
    (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
    (hneg    : ∀ φ : Formula α, C (∼φ))
    (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ➝ ψ))
    (hand    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ⋏ ψ))
    (hor     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ⋎ ψ))
    : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | ⊤       => hverum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | ∼φ      => hneg φ
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => hand φ ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => hor φ ψ

def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hverum  : C ⊤)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (hneg    : ∀ φ : Formula α, C φ → C (∼φ))

  (hor     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ⋎ ψ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | ⊤       => hverum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | ∼φ      => hneg φ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ)
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ) (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor ψ)

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol
import Foundation.Logic.HilbertStyle.Basic

namespace LO.IntProp

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | verum  : Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | neg    : Formula α → Formula α
  | and    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | or     : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

instance : LogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | ∼φ      => "\\lnot " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\rightarrow " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩
instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

end ToString

@[simp] lemma and_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Wedge.wedge]
@[simp] lemma or_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋎ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋎ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Vee.vee]
@[simp] lemma imp_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ➝ φ₂ = ψ₁ ➝ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Arrow.arrow]
@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by simp[Tilde.tilde]

-- lemma neg_def (φ : Formula α) : ∼φ = φ ➝ ⊥ := rfl

lemma iff_def (φ ψ : Formula α) : φ ⭤ ψ = (φ ➝ ψ) ⋏ (ψ ➝ φ) := by rfl

def complexity : Formula α → ℕ
| atom _  => 0
| ⊤       => 0
| ⊥       => 0
| ∼φ      => φ.complexity + 1
| φ ➝ ψ  => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| φ ⋏ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| φ ⋎ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1

@[simp] lemma complexity_bot : complexity (⊥ : Formula α) = 0 := rfl
@[simp] lemma complexity_top : complexity (⊤ : Formula α) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma complexity_atom (a : α) : complexity (atom a) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma complexity_imp (φ ψ : Formula α) : complexity (φ ➝ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1 := rfl
@[simp] lemma complexity_imp' (φ ψ : Formula α) : complexity (imp φ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1 := rfl

@[simp] lemma complexity_and (φ ψ : Formula α) : complexity (φ ⋏ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1 := rfl
@[simp] lemma complexity_and' (φ ψ : Formula α) : complexity (and φ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1 := rfl

@[simp] lemma complexity_or (φ ψ : Formula α) : complexity (φ ⋎ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1 := rfl
@[simp] lemma complexity_or' (φ ψ : Formula α) : complexity (or φ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1 := rfl

@[elab_as_elim]
def cases' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
    (hfalsum : C ⊥)
    (hverum  : C ⊤)
    (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
    (hneg    : ∀ φ : Formula α, C (∼φ))
    (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ➝ ψ))
    (hand    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ⋏ ψ))
    (hor     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ⋎ ψ))
    : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | ⊤       => hverum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | ∼φ      => hneg φ
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => hand φ ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => hor φ ψ

@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hverum  : C ⊤)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (hneg    : ∀ φ : Formula α, C φ → C (∼φ))
  (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ➝ ψ))
  (hand    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ⋏ ψ))
  (hor     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ⋎ ψ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | ⊤       => hverum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | ∼φ      => hneg φ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ)
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ) (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor ψ)
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => hand φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ) (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor ψ)
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => hor φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ) (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor ψ)

section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | ⊤, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _
  | ∼φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hneg φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (by simp[hp])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ⋏ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hand φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ⋎ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hor φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])

instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq

end Decidable

section Encodable

variable [Encodable α]
open Encodable

def toNat : Formula α → ℕ
  | atom a  => (Nat.pair 0 <| encode a) + 1
  | ⊤       => (Nat.pair 1 0) + 1
  | ⊥       => (Nat.pair 2 0) + 1
  | ∼φ      => (Nat.pair 3 <| φ.toNat) + 1
  | φ ➝ ψ   => (Nat.pair 4 <| φ.toNat.pair ψ.toNat) + 1
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => (Nat.pair 5 <| φ.toNat.pair ψ.toNat) + 1
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => (Nat.pair 6 <| φ.toNat.pair ψ.toNat) + 1

def ofNat : ℕ → Option (Formula α)
  | 0 => none
  | e + 1 =>
    let idx := e.unpair.1
    let c := e.unpair.2
    match idx with
    | 0 => (decode c).map Formula.atom
    | 1 => some ⊤
    | 2 => some ⊥
    | 3 =>
      have : c < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c
        return ∼φ
    | 4 =>
      have : c.unpair.1 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_left_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      have : c.unpair.2 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_right_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c.unpair.1
        let ψ <- ofNat c.unpair.2
        return φ ➝ ψ
    | 5 =>
      have : c.unpair.1 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_left_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      have : c.unpair.2 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_right_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c.unpair.1
        let ψ <- ofNat c.unpair.2
        return φ ⋏ ψ
    | 6 =>
      have : c.unpair.1 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_left_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      have : c.unpair.2 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_right_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c.unpair.1
        let ψ <- ofNat c.unpair.2
        return φ ⋎ ψ
    | _ => none

lemma ofNat_toNat : ∀ (φ : Formula α), ofNat (toNat φ) = some φ
  | atom a  => by simp [toNat, ofNat, Nat.unpair_pair, encodek, Option.map_some'];
  | ⊤       => by simp [toNat, ofNat]
  | ⊥       => by simp [toNat, ofNat]
  | ∼φ      => by simp [toNat, ofNat, ofNat_toNat φ]
  | φ ➝ ψ   => by simp [toNat, ofNat, ofNat_toNat φ, ofNat_toNat ψ]
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => by simp [toNat, ofNat, ofNat_toNat φ, ofNat_toNat ψ]
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => by simp [toNat, ofNat, ofNat_toNat φ, ofNat_toNat ψ]

instance : Encodable (Formula α) where
  encode := toNat
  decode := ofNat
  encodek := ofNat_toNat

end Encodable


section subst

def subst  (s : α → Formula α): Formula α → Formula α
  | atom a => s a
  | ⊤      => ⊤
  | ⊥      => ⊥
  | ∼φ     => ∼(φ.subst s)
  | φ ➝ ψ  => φ.subst s ➝ ψ.subst s
  | φ ⋏ ψ  => φ.subst s ⋏ ψ.subst s
  | φ ⋎ ψ  => φ.subst s ⋎ ψ.subst s

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a
C1_dependencies.compilationAlias:

`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | ⊤, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _
  | ∼φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hneg φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (by simp[hp])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ⋏ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hand φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ⋎ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hor φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])

C0_dependencies.name: LO.IntProp.Formula.ofNat
C0_dependencies.content:
def ofNat : ℕ → Option (Formula α)
  | 0 => none
  | e + 1 =>
    let idx := e.unpair.1
    let c := e.unpair.2
    match idx with
    | 0 => (decode c).map Formula.atom
    | 1 => some ⊤
    | 2 => some ⊥
    | 3 =>
      have : c < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c
        return ∼φ
    | 4 =>
      have : c.unpair.1 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_left_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      have : c.unpair.2 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_right_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c.unpair.1
        let ψ <- ofNat c.unpair.2
        return φ ➝ ψ
    | 5 =>
      have : c.unpair.1 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_left_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      have : c.unpair.2 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_right_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c.unpair.1
        let ψ <- ofNat c.unpair.2
        return φ ⋏ ψ
    | 6 =>
      have : c.unpair.1 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_left_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      have : c.unpair.2 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_right_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c.unpair.1
        let ψ <- ofNat c.unpair.2
        return φ ⋎ ψ
    | _ => none

instance : LogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp

  vee := or

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | ∼φ      => "\\lnot " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\rightarrow " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | ⊤, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _
  | ∼φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hneg φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (by simp[hp])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])

    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hand φ' ψ' =>

      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with

        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])

        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])

      have : c.unpair.2 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_right_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do

    case hand φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ⋎ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hor φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])

instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq

end Decidable

section Encodable

variable [Encodable α]
open Encodable

def toNat : Formula α → ℕ
  | atom a  => (Nat.pair 0 <| encode a) + 1
  | ⊤       => (Nat.pair 1 0) + 1
  | ⊥       => (Nat.pair 2 0) + 1
  | ∼φ      => (Nat.pair 3 <| φ.toNat) + 1
  | φ ➝ ψ   => (Nat.pair 4 <| φ.toNat.pair ψ.toNat) + 1
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => (Nat.pair 5 <| φ.toNat.pair ψ.toNat) + 1
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => (Nat.pair 6 <| φ.toNat.pair ψ.toNat) + 1

def ofNat : ℕ → Option (Formula α)
  | 0 => none
  | e + 1 =>
    let idx := e.unpair.1
    let c := e.unpair.2
    match idx with
    | 0 => (decode c).map Formula.atom
    | 1 => some ⊤
    | 2 => some ⊥
    | 3 =>
      have : c < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c
        return ∼φ
    | 4 =>
      have : c.unpair.1 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_left_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      have : c.unpair.2 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_right_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c.unpair.1
        let ψ <- ofNat c.unpair.2
        return φ ➝ ψ
    | 5 =>
      have : c.unpair.1 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_left_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      have : c.unpair.2 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_right_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c.unpair.1
        let ψ <- ofNat c.unpair.2
        return φ ⋏ ψ
    | 6 =>
      have : c.unpair.1 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_left_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      have : c.unpair.2 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_right_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c.unpair.1
        let ψ <- ofNat c.unpair.2
        return φ ⋎ ψ
    | _ => none

lemma ofNat_toNat : ∀ (φ : Formula α), ofNat (toNat φ) = some φ
  | atom a  => by simp [toNat, ofNat, Nat.unpair_pair, encodek, Option.map_some'];
  | ⊤       => by simp [toNat, ofNat]
  | ⊥       => by simp [toNat, ofNat]
  | ∼φ      => by simp [toNat, ofNat, ofNat_toNat φ]
  | φ ➝ ψ   => by simp [toNat, ofNat, ofNat_toNat φ, ofNat_toNat ψ]
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => by simp [toNat, ofNat, ofNat_toNat φ, ofNat_toNat ψ]
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => by simp [toNat, ofNat, ofNat_toNat φ, ofNat_toNat ψ]

instance : Encodable (Formula α) where
  encode := toNat
  decode := ofNat
  encodek := ofNat_toNat

end Encodable


section subst

def subst  (s : α → Formula α): Formula α → Formula α
  | atom a => s a
  | ⊤      => ⊤
  | ⊥      => ⊥
  | ∼φ     => ∼(φ.subst s)
  | φ ➝ ψ  => φ.subst s ➝ ψ.subst s
  | φ ⋏ ψ  => φ.subst s ⋏ ψ.subst s
  | φ ⋎ ψ  => φ.subst s ⋎ ψ.subst s

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | ⊤, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _
  | ∼φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hneg φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (by simp[hp])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ⋏ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hand φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ⋎ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hor φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])

def ofNat : ℕ → Option (Formula α)
  | 0 => none
  | e + 1 =>
    let idx := e.unpair.1
    let c := e.unpair.2
    match idx with
    | 0 => (decode c).map Formula.atom
    | 1 => some ⊤
    | 2 => some ⊥
    | 3 =>
      have : c < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c
        return ∼φ
    | 4 =>
      have : c.unpair.1 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_left_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      have : c.unpair.2 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_right_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c.unpair.1
        let ψ <- ofNat c.unpair.2
        return φ ➝ ψ
    | 5 =>
      have : c.unpair.1 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_left_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      have : c.unpair.2 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_right_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c.unpair.1
        let ψ <- ofNat c.unpair.2
        return φ ⋏ ψ
    | 6 =>
      have : c.unpair.1 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_left_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      have : c.unpair.2 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_right_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c.unpair.1
        let ψ <- ofNat c.unpair.2
        return φ ⋎ ψ
    | _ => none

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol
import Foundation.Logic.HilbertStyle.Basic

namespace LO.IntProp

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | verum  : Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | neg    : Formula α → Formula α
  | and    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | or     : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

instance : LogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | ∼φ      => "\\lnot " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\rightarrow " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩
instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

end ToString

@[simp] lemma and_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Wedge.wedge]
@[simp] lemma or_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋎ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋎ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Vee.vee]
@[simp] lemma imp_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ➝ φ₂ = ψ₁ ➝ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Arrow.arrow]
@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by simp[Tilde.tilde]

-- lemma neg_def (φ : Formula α) : ∼φ = φ ➝ ⊥ := rfl

lemma iff_def (φ ψ : Formula α) : φ ⭤ ψ = (φ ➝ ψ) ⋏ (ψ ➝ φ) := by rfl

def complexity : Formula α → ℕ
| atom _  => 0
| ⊤       => 0
| ⊥       => 0
| ∼φ      => φ.complexity + 1
| φ ➝ ψ  => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| φ ⋏ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| φ ⋎ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1

@[simp] lemma complexity_bot : complexity (⊥ : Formula α) = 0 := rfl
@[simp] lemma complexity_top : complexity (⊤ : Formula α) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma complexity_atom (a : α) : complexity (atom a) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma complexity_imp (φ ψ : Formula α) : complexity (φ ➝ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1 := rfl
@[simp] lemma complexity_imp' (φ ψ : Formula α) : complexity (imp φ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1 := rfl

@[simp] lemma complexity_and (φ ψ : Formula α) : complexity (φ ⋏ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1 := rfl
@[simp] lemma complexity_and' (φ ψ : Formula α) : complexity (and φ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1 := rfl

@[simp] lemma complexity_or (φ ψ : Formula α) : complexity (φ ⋎ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1 := rfl
@[simp] lemma complexity_or' (φ ψ : Formula α) : complexity (or φ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1 := rfl

@[elab_as_elim]
def cases' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
    (hfalsum : C ⊥)
    (hverum  : C ⊤)
    (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
    (hneg    : ∀ φ : Formula α, C (∼φ))
    (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ➝ ψ))
    (hand    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ⋏ ψ))
    (hor     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ⋎ ψ))
    : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | ⊤       => hverum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | ∼φ      => hneg φ
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => hand φ ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => hor φ ψ

@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hverum  : C ⊤)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (hneg    : ∀ φ : Formula α, C φ → C (∼φ))
  (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ➝ ψ))
  (hand    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ⋏ ψ))
  (hor     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ⋎ ψ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | ⊤       => hverum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | ∼φ      => hneg φ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ)
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ) (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor ψ)
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => hand φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ) (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor ψ)
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => hor φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ) (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor ψ)

section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | ⊤, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _
  | ∼φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hneg φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (by simp[hp])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ⋏ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hand φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ⋎ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hor φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])

instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq

end Decidable

section Encodable

variable [Encodable α]
open Encodable

def toNat : Formula α → ℕ
  | atom a  => (Nat.pair 0 <| encode a) + 1
  | ⊤       => (Nat.pair 1 0) + 1
  | ⊥       => (Nat.pair 2 0) + 1
  | ∼φ      => (Nat.pair 3 <| φ.toNat) + 1
  | φ ➝ ψ   => (Nat.pair 4 <| φ.toNat.pair ψ.toNat) + 1
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => (Nat.pair 5 <| φ.toNat.pair ψ.toNat) + 1
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => (Nat.pair 6 <| φ.toNat.pair ψ.toNat) + 1

def ofNat : ℕ → Option (Formula α)
  | 0 => none
  | e + 1 =>
    let idx := e.unpair.1
    let c := e.unpair.2
    match idx with
    | 0 => (decode c).map Formula.atom
    | 1 => some ⊤
    | 2 => some ⊥
    | 3 =>
      have : c < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c
        return ∼φ
    | 4 =>
      have : c.unpair.1 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_left_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      have : c.unpair.2 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_right_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c.unpair.1
        let ψ <- ofNat c.unpair.2
        return φ ➝ ψ
    | 5 =>
      have : c.unpair.1 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_left_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      have : c.unpair.2 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_right_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c.unpair.1
        let ψ <- ofNat c.unpair.2
        return φ ⋏ ψ
    | 6 =>
      have : c.unpair.1 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_left_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      have : c.unpair.2 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_right_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c.unpair.1
        let ψ <- ofNat c.unpair.2
        return φ ⋎ ψ
    | _ => none

lemma ofNat_toNat : ∀ (φ : Formula α), ofNat (toNat φ) = some φ
  | atom a  => by simp [toNat, ofNat, Nat.unpair_pair, encodek, Option.map_some'];
  | ⊤       => by simp [toNat, ofNat]
  | ⊥       => by simp [toNat, ofNat]
  | ∼φ      => by simp [toNat, ofNat, ofNat_toNat φ]
  | φ ➝ ψ   => by simp [toNat, ofNat, ofNat_toNat φ, ofNat_toNat ψ]
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => by simp [toNat, ofNat, ofNat_toNat φ, ofNat_toNat ψ]
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => by simp [toNat, ofNat, ofNat_toNat φ, ofNat_toNat ψ]

instance : Encodable (Formula α) where
  encode := toNat
  decode := ofNat
  encodek := ofNat_toNat

end Encodable


section subst

def subst  (s : α → Formula α): Formula α → Formula α
  | atom a => s a
  | ⊤      => ⊤
  | ⊥      => ⊥
  | ∼φ     => ∼(φ.subst s)
  | φ ➝ ψ  => φ.subst s ➝ ψ.subst s
  | φ ⋏ ψ  => φ.subst s ⋏ ψ.subst s
  | φ ⋎ ψ  => φ.subst s ⋎ ψ.subst s

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | ⊤, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _
  | ∼φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hneg φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (by simp[hp])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ⋏ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hand φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ⋎ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hor φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])

def ofNat : ℕ → Option (Formula α)
  | 0 => none
  | e + 1 =>
    let idx := e.unpair.1
    let c := e.unpair.2
    match idx with
    | 0 => (decode c).map Formula.atom
    | 1 => some ⊤
    | 2 => some ⊥
    | 3 =>
      have : c < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c
        return ∼φ
    | 4 =>
      have : c.unpair.1 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_left_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      have : c.unpair.2 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_right_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c.unpair.1
        let ψ <- ofNat c.unpair.2
        return φ ➝ ψ
    | 5 =>
      have : c.unpair.1 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_left_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      have : c.unpair.2 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_right_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c.unpair.1
        let ψ <- ofNat c.unpair.2
        return φ ⋏ ψ
    | 6 =>
      have : c.unpair.1 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_left_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      have : c.unpair.2 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_right_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c.unpair.1

    | _ => none

def toStr : Formula α → String
  | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | ∼φ      => "\\lnot " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\rightarrow " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol
import Foundation.Logic.HilbertStyle.Basic

namespace LO.IntProp

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | verum  : Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | neg    : Formula α → Formula α
  | and    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | or     : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

instance : LogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | ∼φ      => "\\lnot " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\rightarrow " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩
instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

end ToString

@[simp] lemma and_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Wedge.wedge]
@[simp] lemma or_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋎ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋎ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Vee.vee]
@[simp] lemma imp_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ➝ φ₂ = ψ₁ ➝ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Arrow.arrow]
@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by simp[Tilde.tilde]

-- lemma neg_def (φ : Formula α) : ∼φ = φ ➝ ⊥ := rfl

lemma iff_def (φ ψ : Formula α) : φ ⭤ ψ = (φ ➝ ψ) ⋏ (ψ ➝ φ) := by rfl

def complexity : Formula α → ℕ
| atom _  => 0
| ⊤       => 0
| ⊥       => 0
| ∼φ      => φ.complexity + 1
| φ ➝ ψ  => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| φ ⋏ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| φ ⋎ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1

@[simp] lemma complexity_bot : complexity (⊥ : Formula α) = 0 := rfl
@[simp] lemma complexity_top : complexity (⊤ : Formula α) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma complexity_atom (a : α) : complexity (atom a) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma complexity_imp' (φ ψ : Formula α) : complexity (imp φ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1 := rfl

def cases' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
    (hfalsum : C ⊥)
    (hverum  : C ⊤)
    (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
    (hneg    : ∀ φ : Formula α, C (∼φ))
    (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ➝ ψ))
    (hand    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ⋏ ψ))
    (hor     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ⋎ ψ))
    : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | ⊤       => hverum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | ∼φ      => hneg φ
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => hand φ ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => hor φ ψ

def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hverum  : C ⊤)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (hneg    : ∀ φ : Formula α, C φ → C (∼φ))

  (hand    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ⋏ ψ))
  (hor     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ⋎ ψ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | ⊤       => hverum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | ∼φ      => hneg φ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ)
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ) (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor ψ)
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => hand φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ) (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor ψ)
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => hor φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ) (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor ψ)

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol
import Foundation.Logic.HilbertStyle.Basic

namespace LO.IntProp

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | verum  : Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | neg    : Formula α → Formula α
  | and    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | or     : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

instance : LogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | ∼φ      => "\\lnot " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\rightarrow " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩
instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

end ToString

@[simp] lemma and_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Wedge.wedge]
@[simp] lemma or_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋎ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋎ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Vee.vee]
@[simp] lemma imp_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ➝ φ₂ = ψ₁ ➝ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Arrow.arrow]
@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by simp[Tilde.tilde]

-- lemma neg_def (φ : Formula α) : ∼φ = φ ➝ ⊥ := rfl

lemma iff_def (φ ψ : Formula α) : φ ⭤ ψ = (φ ➝ ψ) ⋏ (ψ ➝ φ) := by rfl

def complexity : Formula α → ℕ
| atom _  => 0
| ⊤       => 0
| ⊥       => 0
| ∼φ      => φ.complexity + 1
| φ ➝ ψ  => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| φ ⋏ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| φ ⋎ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1

@[simp] lemma complexity_bot : complexity (⊥ : Formula α) = 0 := rfl
@[simp] lemma complexity_top : complexity (⊤ : Formula α) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma complexity_atom (a : α) : complexity (atom a) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma complexity_imp (φ ψ : Formula α) : complexity (φ ➝ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1 := rfl
@[simp] lemma complexity_imp' (φ ψ : Formula α) : complexity (imp φ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1 := rfl

@[simp] lemma complexity_and (φ ψ : Formula α) : complexity (φ ⋏ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1 := rfl
@[simp] lemma complexity_and' (φ ψ : Formula α) : complexity (and φ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1 := rfl

@[simp] lemma complexity_or (φ ψ : Formula α) : complexity (φ ⋎ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1 := rfl
@[simp] lemma complexity_or' (φ ψ : Formula α) : complexity (or φ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1 := rfl

@[elab_as_elim]
def cases' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
    (hfalsum : C ⊥)
    (hverum  : C ⊤)
    (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
    (hneg    : ∀ φ : Formula α, C (∼φ))
    (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ➝ ψ))
    (hand    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ⋏ ψ))
    (hor     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ⋎ ψ))
    : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | ⊤       => hverum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | ∼φ      => hneg φ
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => hand φ ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => hor φ ψ

@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hverum  : C ⊤)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (hneg    : ∀ φ : Formula α, C φ → C (∼φ))
  (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ➝ ψ))
  (hand    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ⋏ ψ))
  (hor     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ⋎ ψ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | ⊤       => hverum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | ∼φ      => hneg φ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ)
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ) (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor ψ)
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => hand φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ) (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor ψ)
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => hor φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ) (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor ψ)

section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | ⊤, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _
  | ∼φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hneg φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (by simp[hp])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ⋏ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hand φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ⋎ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hor φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])

instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq

end Decidable

section Encodable

variable [Encodable α]
open Encodable

def toNat : Formula α → ℕ
  | atom a  => (Nat.pair 0 <| encode a) + 1
  | ⊤       => (Nat.pair 1 0) + 1
  | ⊥       => (Nat.pair 2 0) + 1
  | ∼φ      => (Nat.pair 3 <| φ.toNat) + 1
  | φ ➝ ψ   => (Nat.pair 4 <| φ.toNat.pair ψ.toNat) + 1
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => (Nat.pair 5 <| φ.toNat.pair ψ.toNat) + 1
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => (Nat.pair 6 <| φ.toNat.pair ψ.toNat) + 1

def ofNat : ℕ → Option (Formula α)
  | 0 => none
  | e + 1 =>
    let idx := e.unpair.1
    let c := e.unpair.2
    match idx with
    | 0 => (decode c).map Formula.atom
    | 1 => some ⊤
    | 2 => some ⊥
    | 3 =>
      have : c < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c
        return ∼φ
    | 4 =>
      have : c.unpair.1 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_left_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      have : c.unpair.2 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_right_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c.unpair.1
        let ψ <- ofNat c.unpair.2
        return φ ➝ ψ
    | 5 =>
      have : c.unpair.1 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_left_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      have : c.unpair.2 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_right_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c.unpair.1
        let ψ <- ofNat c.unpair.2
        return φ ⋏ ψ
    | 6 =>
      have : c.unpair.1 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_left_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      have : c.unpair.2 < e + 1 := Nat.lt_succ.mpr $ le_trans (Nat.unpair_right_le _) $ Nat.unpair_right_le _
      do
        let φ <- ofNat c.unpair.1
        let ψ <- ofNat c.unpair.2
        return φ ⋎ ψ
    | _ => none

lemma ofNat_toNat : ∀ (φ : Formula α), ofNat (toNat φ) = some φ
  | atom a  => by simp [toNat, ofNat, Nat.unpair_pair, encodek, Option.map_some'];

  | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"

  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\rightarrow " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

C0_dependencies.name: LO.IntProp.Formula.hasDecEq
C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | ⊤, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _
  | ∼φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hneg φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (by simp[hp])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ⋏ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hand φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ⋎ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hor φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])

namespace LO.IntProp

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | verum  : Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | neg    : Formula α → Formula α
  | and    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | or     : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

instance : LogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | ∼φ      => "\\lnot " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\rightarrow " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩
instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

end ToString

@[simp] lemma and_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Wedge.wedge]
@[simp] lemma or_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋎ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋎ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Vee.vee]
@[simp] lemma imp_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ➝ φ₂ = ψ₁ ➝ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Arrow.arrow]
@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by simp[Tilde.tilde]

lemma iff_def (φ ψ : Formula α) : φ ⭤ ψ = (φ ➝ ψ) ⋏ (ψ ➝ φ) := by rfl

def complexity : Formula α → ℕ
| atom _  => 0
| ⊤       => 0
| ⊥       => 0
| ∼φ      => φ.complexity + 1
| φ ➝ ψ  => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| φ ⋏ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| φ ⋎ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1

def cases' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
    (hfalsum : C ⊥)
    (hverum  : C ⊤)
    (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
    (hneg    : ∀ φ : Formula α, C (∼φ))
    (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ➝ ψ))
    (hand    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ⋏ ψ))
    (hor     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ⋎ ψ))
    : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | ⊤       => hverum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | ∼φ      => hneg φ
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => hand φ ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => hor φ ψ

def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hverum  : C ⊤)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (hneg    : ∀ φ : Formula α, C φ → C (∼φ))
  (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ➝ ψ))
  (hand    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ⋏ ψ))
  (hor     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ⋎ ψ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | ⊤       => hverum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | ∼φ      => hneg φ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ)
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ) (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor ψ)
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => hand φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ) (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor ψ)
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => hor φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ) (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor ψ)

section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | ⊤, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _
  | ∼φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hneg φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (by simp[hp])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ⋏ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hand φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ⋎ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hor φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])

instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq

end Decidable

def toNat : Formula α → ℕ
  | atom a  => (Nat.pair 0 <| encode a) + 1

  | φ ⋎ ψ   => (Nat.pair 6 <| φ.toNat.pair ψ.toNat) + 1

def ofNat : ℕ → Option (Formula α)

    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | ⊤, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }

    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol
import Foundation.Logic.HilbertStyle.Basic

namespace LO.IntProp

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | verum  : Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | neg    : Formula α → Formula α
  | and    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | or     : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

instance : LogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | ∼φ      => "\\lnot " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\rightarrow " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩
instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

end ToString

      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])

    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hor φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])

instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq

  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | ⊤, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }

    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }

      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with

    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }

  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr : Formula α → String
  | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | ∼φ      => "\\lnot " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\rightarrow " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | ⊤, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _
  | ∼φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hneg φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (by simp[hp])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])

    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>

    case hor φ' ψ' =>

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol
import Foundation.Logic.HilbertStyle.Basic

namespace LO.IntProp

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | verum  : Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | neg    : Formula α → Formula α
  | and    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | or     : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

instance : LogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | ∼φ      => "\\lnot " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\rightarrow " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩
instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

end ToString

@[simp] lemma and_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Wedge.wedge]
@[simp] lemma or_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋎ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋎ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Vee.vee]
@[simp] lemma imp_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ➝ φ₂ = ψ₁ ➝ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Arrow.arrow]
@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by simp[Tilde.tilde]

lemma iff_def (φ ψ : Formula α) : φ ⭤ ψ = (φ ➝ ψ) ⋏ (ψ ➝ φ) := by rfl

def complexity : Formula α → ℕ
| atom _  => 0
| ⊤       => 0
| ⊥       => 0
| ∼φ      => φ.complexity + 1
| φ ➝ ψ  => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| φ ⋏ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1

@[elab_as_elim]
def cases' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
    (hfalsum : C ⊥)
    (hverum  : C ⊤)
    (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
    (hneg    : ∀ φ : Formula α, C (∼φ))
    (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ➝ ψ))
    (hand    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ⋏ ψ))
    (hor     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ⋎ ψ))
    : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | ⊤       => hverum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | ∼φ      => hneg φ
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => hand φ ψ
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => hor φ ψ

@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hverum  : C ⊤)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (hneg    : ∀ φ : Formula α, C φ → C (∼φ))
  (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ➝ ψ))
  (hand    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ⋏ ψ))
  (hor     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ⋎ ψ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | ⊤       => hverum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | ∼φ      => hneg φ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ)
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ) (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor ψ)
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => hand φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ) (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor ψ)
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => hor φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor φ) (rec' hfalsum hverum hatom hneg himp hand hor ψ)

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | ⊤, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _
  | ∼φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hneg φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (by simp[hp])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ⋏ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hand φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | φ ⋎ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case hor φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol
import Foundation.Logic.HilbertStyle.Basic

namespace LO.IntProp

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | verum  : Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | neg    : Formula α → Formula α
  | and    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | or     : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

instance : LogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | ∼φ      => "\\lnot " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\rightarrow " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩
instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

end ToString

def toStr : Formula α → String
  | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | ∼φ      => "\\lnot " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\rightarrow " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

informal_statement: Substituting any term into the false formula $\bot$ results in $\bot$ itself.
informal_proof: By definition, substituting any term into the formula $\bot$ does not alter its truth value. The false formula $\bot$ remains false regardless of the substitution applied, so substituting into $\bot$ results in $\bot$.

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol
import Foundation.Logic.HilbertStyle.Basic

namespace LO.IntProp

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | verum  : Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | neg    : Formula α → Formula α
  | and    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | or     : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

instance : LogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | ∼φ      => "\\lnot " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\rightarrow " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩
instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

end ToString

@[simp] lemma and_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Wedge.wedge]
@[simp] lemma or_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋎ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋎ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Vee.vee]
@[simp] lemma imp_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ➝ φ₂ = ψ₁ ➝ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Arrow.arrow]
@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by simp[Tilde.tilde]

-- lemma neg_def (φ : Formula α) : ∼φ = φ ➝ ⊥ := rfl

lemma iff_def (φ ψ : Formula α) : φ ⭤ ψ = (φ ➝ ψ) ⋏ (ψ ➝ φ) := by rfl

def complexity : Formula α → ℕ
| atom _  => 0
| ⊤       => 0
| ⊥       => 0
| ∼φ      => φ.complexity + 1
| φ ➝ ψ  => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| φ ⋏ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| φ ⋎ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1

@[simp] lemma complexity_bot : complexity (⊥ : Formula α) = 0 := rfl
@[simp] lemma complexity_top : complexity (⊤ : Formula α) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma complexity_atom (a : α) : complexity (atom a) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma complexity_imp (φ ψ : Formula α) : complexity (φ ➝ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1 := rfl
@[simp] lemma complexity_imp' (φ ψ : Formula α) : complexity (imp φ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1 := rfl

@[simp] lemma complexity_and (φ ψ : Formula α) : complexity (φ ⋏ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1 := rfl
@[simp] lemma complexity_and' (φ ψ : Formula α) : complexity (and φ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1 := rfl

@[simp] lemma complexity_or (φ ψ : Formula α) : complexity (φ ⋎ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1 := rfl
@[simp] lemma complexity_or' (φ ψ : Formula α) : complexity (or φ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1 := rfl

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

informal_statement: For every natural number \( n \), there exists a prime number \( p \) such that \( p \) is greater than \( n \). Equivalently, there are infinitely many prime numbers.
informal_proof:
First, let’s consider an arbitrary natural number \( n \). We wish to show that there exists a prime number \( p \) such that \( p > n \). To do this, consider the number \( (n + 1)! + 1 \), where \( ! \) denotes the factorial operation.

The factorial \( (n + 1)! \) is the product of all positive integers up to \( n + 1 \). Therefore, \( (n + 1)! \) is greater than or equal to \( 2 \), and so \( (n + 1)! + 1 \) is at least \( 3 \).

Now, by the fundamental theorem of arithmetic, every integer greater than 1 has at least one prime factor. Let \( p \) be a prime factor of \( (n + 1)! + 1 \). We assert that \( p \) must be greater than \( n \).

Assume, for contradiction, that \( p \leq n \). Since \( p \) is a prime factor of \( (n + 1)! \), it divides \( (n + 1)! \). Additionally, by definition, \( p \) divides \( (n + 1)! + 1 \). Therefore, \( p \) divides the difference between these two numbers:

\[
((n + 1)! + 1) - (n + 1)! = 1
\]

This implies that \( p \) divides \( 1 \). However, the only positive integer that divides \( 1 \) is \( 1 \) itself, which contradicts the fact that \( p \) is a prime number, as primes are greater than \( 1 \).

Therefore, our initial assumption must be false, and it follows that \( p > n \).

Hence, for every natural number \( n \), there exists a prime number \( p \) such that \( p > n \), demonstrating that there are infinitely many prime numbers.

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

informal_statement: If φ implies ψ, then substituting any term s into both φ and ψ maintains the implication φ → ψ.
informal_proof: Assume that φ implies ψ. When we substitute a term s into both φ and ψ, we obtain φ[s] and ψ[s]. Since substitution is a syntactic operation that replaces terms within the logical expressions, the implication is preserved. If φ → ψ is true, and both φ and ψ are substituted with φ[s] and ψ[s] respectively, then φ[s] implies ψ[s] must also hold. This is because substitution maintains the logical structure of the implication, ensuring that if φ implies ψ before substitution, their substituted versions φ[s] and ψ[s] preserve this implication. The result follows directly from the properties of substitution and implication in formal logic.

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol
import Foundation.Logic.HilbertStyle.Basic

namespace LO.IntProp

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | verum  : Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | neg    : Formula α → Formula α
  | and    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | or     : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

instance : LogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | ∼φ      => "\\lnot " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\rightarrow " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

informal_statement: Substitution distributes over disjunction, meaning that substituting a term for a variable in a disjunction of two formulas results in the disjunction of the substituted formulas.
informal_proof: Substitution, by its definition in formal logic, applies separately to each disjunct in a disjunction. Therefore, substituting a term \( s \) for a variable in a disjunction \( \varphi \lor \psi \) is equivalent to substituting \( s \) into each individual formula \( \varphi \) and \( \psi \) and then forming the disjunction of the substituted formulas. This preservation of structure under substitution confirms the distributivity of substitution over disjunction.

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

informal_statement: Substituting a term into a conjunction of two propositions is equivalent to substituting the term into each proposition separately and then forming their conjunction.
informal_proof:
To see why this is true, consider that substitution operates uniformly across logical connectives. When applied to a conjunction (φ ∧ ψ), substitution replaces the relevant term in both φ and ψ. Since the conjunction of the substituted terms maintains the logical structure of the original conjunction, it follows that substituting into the conjunction (φ ∧ ψ).subst s results in (φ.subst s). 
Similarly, substituting separately into each component (φ.subst s ∧ ψ.subst s) preserves the relation due to the definition of substitution in propositional logic. Since both operations yield equivalent results, we have the equality by definition. Therefore, the substitution into the conjunction equals the conjunction of substitutions.

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

informal_statement: The `subst` function takes a substitution function `s` and a well-formed formula (wff) and substitutes each occurrence of an atomic proposition in the formula with the corresponding proposition given by `s`. This substitution is uniformly applied across all parts of the formula, preserving the logical connectives and structure.
informal_proof:
To formally establish that the `subst` function behaves as described, we will use an inductive proof based on the structure of well-formed formulas (wff). We will consider each case of the formula's construction and verify that `subst` applies the substitution uniformly.

1. **Base Case (Atomic Propositions):**  
   For an atomic proposition `a`, by definition:
   ```
   subst s (Atom a) = s a
   ```

   For a formula `∼φ`, the substitution is:

   subst s (∼φ) = ∼(φ.subst s)
